run.question: Search the 'app-183c-logs' index for ERROR level log messages. What error codes (format ERR-XXXX) appear in the logs?

report.summary: Search of the 'app-183c-logs' index found 3 ERROR-level documents, containing three distinct error codes in the ERR-XXXX format: ERR-7291, ERR-4058 and ERR-9463. The whole index holds 7 documents (docs.count=7) and a match_all query with size 100 returned all 7 with documents_omitted=0, so no additional ERROR documents lie outside the returned set within the sampled window (2026-11-23T16:11:05Z to 2026-11-23T17:11:05Z, the default query window applied to the timestamp field). The ERROR entries are: payment-api 16:49:00Z 'Database connection timeout - ERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s'; order-service 16:54:00Z 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format'; inventory-api 17:04:00Z 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503'. The remaining 4 documents are INFO/WARN and carry no error_code. This was a read-only log-extraction question; no fault analysis, remediation or recovery certification was performed or is implied.

ERROR log at 2026-11-23T16:54:00Z from service order-service, error_code ERR-4058, message 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format' (document _id V5pjCaIBNF6Vc4WVsS7V).
ERROR log at 2026-11-23T17:04:00Z from service inventory-api, error_code ERR-9463, message 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503' (document _id WZpjCaIBNF6Vc4WVsS7V).

A match_all query with size 100 over app-183c-logs returned all 7 documents (total eq 7, documents_omitted 0, sorted by timestamp 2026-11-23T16:44:00Z to 2026-11-23T17:09:00Z); the 4 non-ERROR documents are level INFO or WARN and carry no error_code field.
The index app-183c-logs is mapped with fields timestamp (date), level (keyword), service (keyword), error_code (keyword) and message (text), and held 7 documents with green health at query time.

The non-ERROR context shows the payment-api outage may have recovered within its own service: payment-api INFO 'Service started successfully' at 16:44:00Z is followed by the ERR-7291 timeout at 16:49:00Z and a WARN 'Retrying database connection' at 16:50:00Z, and inventory-api logs INFO 'Recovered from temporary outage' at 17:09:00Z. These are log lines only; no metric or trace evidence was checked, so neither recovery nor ongoing impact is established.

gaps: The Elasticsearch search time filter is fixed to the default query window 2026-11-23T16:11:05Z-2026-11-23T17:11:05Z; documents with timestamps outside that hour are not observable through this tool, though the index's current docs.count of 7 matches the 7 documents returned, so no additional documents were found in the index at query time.
Level values were matched only as the exact keyword 'ERROR'; other error-like levels (for example 'error', 'FATAL', 'CRITICAL') were not queried, so any such documents are unknown.

Whether these three error codes recur outside the app-183c-logs index, and whether they caused user-visible or downstream impact, was not verified; no application metrics or traces were queried for this question.
next_steps: If impact matters, correlate ERR-7291 (payment-api), ERR-4058 (order-service) and ERR-9463 (inventory-api) with payment-api/order-service error spans and error-rate metrics over the same window.
